items.stem: Which artifact pack best supports a complete handoff?

options.text: Hypothesis, priorities, workflow maps, value assumptions, metrics, decisions, validation and MAP.
Only a signed attendance sheet.
Only a deck cover and a large savings number.
Only a product release list.

items.stem: What makes an action plan mutual?

options.text: The seller writes dates privately.
The AI tool marks it mutually accepted.
The customer and relevant owners agree commitments, dependencies and dates.
Every milestone is assigned to the customer without discussion.

items.stem: How should conditional and deferred decisions be documented?

options.text: Removed from the record.
All relabeled as approved.
Sent without context to unrelated customer users.
Explicit status, rationale, decision owner and follow-up condition/date.

items.stem: How should partner services attach to the roadmap?

options.text: Through automatic contract acceptance after discovery.
Through scoped outcomes and dependencies tied to the prioritized customer needs.
By promising unsupported custom features.
By selling every available SKU regardless of need.

items.stem: What must accompany a presale ROI model in a CS handoff?

options.text: Definitions, baselines/plans, cohort, data owners, assumptions, caveats and review cadence.
Only the optimistic total.
A statement that future measurement is unnecessary.
Only the spreadsheet password.

items.stem: Usage increases but the business KPI is flat. What should happen?

options.text: Claim financial ROI based only on usage.
Delete the KPI.
Expand the model by assuming every run creates revenue.
Investigate workflow fit, quality, data, measurement lag and reallocation before claiming value.

items.stem: Which statement is appropriate for a recap after conditional sponsor alignment?

options.text: Rollout is fully approved and all risks are closed.
The pilot is approved because people liked the session.
The outcome hypothesis is accepted subject to named access and baseline validation actions.
Every customer user has accepted the implementation scope.

items.stem: Who should accept the discovery-to-delivery handoff?

options.text: An unrelated event attendee.
Only an automated ZIP checksum tool.
The named receiving delivery/value owner with unresolved risks documented.
No one; a file upload proves acceptance.
